## Enrollment by sector and peer group

```{ojs}
viewof grp = Inputs.radio(new Map([["Sectors", "sector"], ["Peer groups", "peer"]]), {value: param("g", "sector"), label: "Groups"})
viewof base = Inputs.radio(new Map([["FY1990 = 100", 1990], ["FY2012 = 100", 2012]]), {value: +param("base", 2012), label: "Index"})
```

```{ojs}
{
  setParam("g", grp === "sector" ? null : grp); setParam("base", base === 2012 ? null : base);
  const PC = {flag: BLUE, reg: "#eb6834", small: "#008300", largepb: "#6250d6"};
  const rows = FI.filter(d => d.kind === grp);
  const b = new Map(rows.filter(d => d.fy === base).map(d => [d.key, d.total_fte]));
  const pts = rows.map(d => ({...d, v: 100 * d.total_fte / b.get(d.key), c: grp === "sector" ? SECC[d.key] : PC[d.key]}));
  const keys = [...new Set(pts.map(d => d.key))];
  const lab = Object.fromEntries(pts.map(d => [d.key, d.label]));
  const narrow = width < 640;
  const dom = d3.extent(pts, d => d.v);
  const ends = spreadLabels(keys.map(k => { const l = pts.filter(d => d.key === k).at(-1); return {x: l.fy, y: l.v, label: `${l.label} ${f0(l.v)}`}; }), {domain: dom, height: 380});
  return Plot.plot({
    width: Math.min(width, 980), height: 380, marginRight: narrow ? 10 : 190, marginLeft: 44,
    x: {...yearAxis, domain: [1988, 2025]}, y: {grid: true, domain: dom, label: `Fall FTE students, FY${base} = 100`},
    color: {domain: keys.map(k => lab[k]), range: keys.map(k => pts.find(d => d.key === k).c), legend: narrow},
    marks: [Plot.ruleY([100], {stroke: "#bbb"}), Plot.ruleX([2012], {stroke: "#bbb", strokeDasharray: "3,3"}),
      Plot.lineY(pts, {x: "fy", y: "v", stroke: "label", strokeWidth: 2}),
      narrow ? null : Plot.text(ends, {x: "x", y: "ly", text: "label", dx: 6, textAnchor: "start", fontSize: 10, fill: INK}),
      Plot.tip(pts, Plot.pointer({x: "fy", y: "v", title: d => `${d.label}, FY${d.fy}\nindex ${f1(d.v)}\n${f0(d.total_fte)} FTE students, ${d.n} institutions`}))]
  });
}
```

```{ojs}
      Plot.tip(rows, Plot.pointerY({y: "l", x: "share_shrank", title: d => `${d.l}\n${pct0(d.share_shrank)} shrank; ${pct0(d.share_shrank_10pct)} by more than 10%\nmedian change ${s1(100 * d.median)} log pts\nsector total ${s1(d.pct_change_total)}% (S11)\n${d.n} institutions`}))]
  });
}
```

::: {.cs-note}
Fall FTE students (full-time plus part-time converted with the NCES Digest part-time factors, as in Delta Cost), surviving sets: S24 for the index (1,909 institutions), S11 for the share that shrank (2,038). Peer groups: **flagships** are each state's flagship campus with its own branches (42 states; 8 states whose flagship sits inside a system-wide unit are excluded); **regional publics** are public master's and bachelor's colleges other than flagships; **small privates** are private bachelor's colleges with fewer than 2,000 FTE students in FY2012. Survivor sets exclude colleges that closed, which were mostly small and shrinking, so declines are understated. FY2024–25 NCES provisional.
:::

## Staff or students? Decomposing the rise in staff per student

The change in staff per student is the change in staff minus the change in students (in log points, about percent). Bars to the right of zero raise staff per student; a falling enrollment bar (the denominator) raises it too.

{{< include ../_toggles.qmd >}}

```{ojs}
viewof by = Inputs.select(new Map([["All institutions", "all"], ["Sector", "sector"], ["Enrollment-growth third (within sector)", "third"], ["Enrollment rose or fell", "rosefell"], ["Peer group", "peer"], ["Online enrollment rose or fell", "online"]]), {value: param("by", "sector"), label: "Group by"})
viewof ver = Inputs.select(new Map([["Total FTE, FY2013–24 (headline)", "b"], ["On-campus FTE only, FY2013–24", "c"], ["Total FTE, FY2012–24 (continuous categories only)", "a"]]), {value: param("v", "b"), label: "Students"})
viewof dm = Inputs.select(MEAS.map(d => d.k), {format: k => MEASL[k], value: param("dm", "total"), label: "Staff"})
```

```{ojs}
{
  setParam("by", by === "sector" ? null : by); setParam("v", ver === "b" ? null : ver); setParam("dm", dm === "total" ? null : dm);
  const p = wt === "w" ? "w" : "u";
  const rows = DE.filter(d => d.grouping === by && d.ver === ver && d.measure === dm);
  if (!rows.length) return md`*No FY2012–24 decomposition for this category: it is not comparable across the 2012–13 HR redesign. Choose FY2013–24.*`;
  const order = by === "sector" ? SECTORS.map(s => s.l).filter(l => rows.some(r => r.group === l)) : rows.map(d => d.group);
  const COMP = ["Staff", "Students (denominator)", "Staff per student"];
  const long = rows.flatMap(d => [
    {g: d.group, c: "Staff", v: d[`${p}_staff`]}, {g: d.group, c: "Students (denominator)", v: d[`${p}_den`]}, {g: d.group, c: "Staff per student", v: d[`${p}_ratio`]}].map(x => ({...x, n: d.n, a: d[`${p}aa`], b: d[`${p}ab`], w: d.window})));
  const narrow = width < 640;
  return html`${Plot.plot({
    width: Math.min(width, 900), height: 50 + order.length * 66, marginLeft: narrow ? 110 : 210, marginRight: 50,
    x: {grid: true, insetLeft: 36, insetRight: 36, label: `Log points ×100, ${rows[0].window.replace("FY2013-FY2024", "FY2013–24").replace("FY2012-FY2024", "FY2012–24")} (${wlab})`},
    y: {domain: COMP, axis: null}, fy: {domain: order, label: null},
    color: {domain: COMP, range: [LIGHT, GRAY, BLUE], legend: true},
    marks: [Plot.ruleX([0], {stroke: INK}),
      Plot.barX(long, {fy: "g", y: "c", x: "v", fill: "c", inset: 1}),
      Plot.text(long.filter(d => d.v < 0), {fy: "g", y: "c", x: "v", text: d => s1(d.v), dx: -4, textAnchor: "end", fontSize: 10, fill: INK}),
      Plot.text(long.filter(d => d.v >= 0), {fy: "g", y: "c", x: "v", text: d => s1(d.v), dx: 4, textAnchor: "start", fontSize: 10, fill: INK}),
      Plot.tip(long, Plot.pointerY({fy: "g", y: "c", x: "v", title: d => `${d.g}: ${d.c} ${s1(d.v)}\nstaff per 1,000: ${f1(d.a)} → ${f1(d.b)}\n${d.n} institutions`}))]
  })}
  <div class="cs-scroll"><table class="cs-sectab"><thead><tr><th>Group</th><th>n</th><th>Per 1,000, start</th><th>Per 1,000, FY2024</th><th>Staff</th><th>Students</th><th>Staff per student</th></tr></thead><tbody>
  ${order.map(g => { const d = rows.find(r => r.group === g); return html`<tr><td>${g}</td><td>${d.n}</td><td>${f1(d[`${p}aa`])}</td><td>${f1(d[`${p}ab`])}</td><td>${s1(d[`${p}_staff`])}</td><td>${s1(d[`${p}_den`])}</td><td><b>${s1(d[`${p}_ratio`])}</b></td></tr>`; })}
  </tbody></table></div>`;
}
```

::: {.cs-note}
S11 surviving set (2,038 institutions). Unweighted: means of institution log changes, so the identity holds exactly for the typical institution. Weighted: log changes of group totals. On-campus FTE removes students enrolled exclusively online (IPEDS distance-education counts), so it shows staff per student actually on campus. Growth thirds are formed within each sector on FY2012–24 FTE change. The FY2012–24 version is the earlier (item 10) window; it can't be used for EAM, professional or nonprofessional staff because of the HR redesign. FY2024 NCES provisional.
:::

```{ojs}
viewof onw = Inputs.radio(new Map([["Typical institution", "unw"], ["All students together", "w"]]), {value: param("ow", "unw"), label: "Share"})
```

```{ojs}
{
  setParam("ow", onw === "unw" ? null : onw);
  const pts = ON.filter(d => d.sec !== "all").map(d => ({...d, v: d[`exc_share_hc_${onw}`], l: SECL[d.sec]}));

  const dom = [0, d3.max(pts, d => d.v) * 1.05];
  const ends = spreadLabels([...SECTORS.map(s => { const l = pts.filter(d => d.sec === s.k).at(-1); return {x: l.fy, y: l.v, label: `${s.l} ${pct0(l.v)}`}; }), {x: all.at(-1).fy, y: all.at(-1).v, label: `All ${pct1(all.at(-1).v)}`}], {domain: dom, height: 340});
  return Plot.plot({
    width: Math.min(width, 900), height: 340, marginRight: narrow ? 10 : 160, title: "Share of fall headcount enrolled exclusively online",
    x: {...yearAxis}, y: {grid: true, domain: dom, tickFormat: "%", label: null},
    color: {domain: SECTORS.map(s => s.l), range: SECTORS.map(s => s.c), legend: narrow},
    marks: [Plot.rectX([{a: 2020.5, b: 2022.5}], {x1: "a", x2: "b", fill: SHADE}),
      Plot.lineY(pts, {x: "fy", y: "v", stroke: "l", strokeWidth: 1.6}),
      Plot.lineY(all, {x: "fy", y: "v", stroke: INK, strokeWidth: 2.6, strokeDasharray: "6,3"}),
      Plot.text(all, Plot.selectFirst({x: "fy", y: "v", text: d => `All ${pct1(d.v)}`, dy: -12, dx: 4, textAnchor: "start", fontSize: 11, fill: INK})),
      narrow ? null : Plot.text(ends, {x: "x", y: "ly", text: "label", dx: 6, textAnchor: "start", fontSize: 10, fill: INK}),
      Plot.tip(pts, Plot.pointer({x: "fy", y: "v", title: d => `${d.l}, FY${d.fy}: ${pct1(d.v)} exclusively online\n${d.period}`}))]
  });
}
```

```{ojs}
{
  const p = wt === "w" ? "w" : "u";
  const rows = SECTORS.map(s => {
    const b = DE.find(d => d.grouping === "sector" && d.group === s.l && d.ver === "b" && d.measure === "total");
    const c = DE.find(d => d.grouping === "sector" && d.group === s.l && d.ver === "c" && d.measure === "total");
    return [{l: s.l, k: "All students", v: b[`${p}_ratio`]}, {l: s.l, k: "On-campus students", v: c[`${p}_ratio`]}];
  }).flat();
  return Plot.plot({
    width: Math.min(width, 820), height: 360, marginLeft: 140, marginRight: 50, title: "Rise in staff per student, FY2013–24: all students vs on-campus students",
    x: {grid: true, label: `Log points ×100 (${wlab})`}, y: {domain: ["All students", "On-campus students"], axis: null}, fy: {domain: SECTORS.map(s => s.l), label: null},
    color: {domain: ["All students", "On-campus students"], range: [BLUE, LIGHT], legend: true},
    marks: [Plot.ruleX([0]), Plot.barX(rows, {fy: "l", y: "k", x: "v", fill: "k", inset: 1}),
      Plot.text(rows, {fy: "l", y: "k", x: "v", text: d => s1(d.v), dx: 4, textAnchor: "start", fontSize: 10, fill: INK})]
  });
}
```

::: {.cs-note}
Exclusively online students as a share of fall headcount, S24 set. Falls 2020–21 (shaded, FY2021–22) are distorted by COVID; FY2025 is NCES provisional. Counting only on-campus students more than doubles the rise in staff per student: online growth offset about half of the fall in on-campus enrollment.
:::

## Dual enrollment

High-school students taking college courses are counted as college enrollment. Their growth hides part of the community-college decline. IPEDS has no dual-enrollment item, so the proxy is undergraduates under 18, converted to FTE.

<div class="cs-two">

```{ojs}
{
  const rows = DS.filter(d => d.sg !== "all").map(d => ({...d, l: SGL[d.sg], f: String(d.fall)}));
  return Plot.plot({
    width: half(width), height: 320, marginLeft: 190, marginRight: 50, title: "Dual enrollment, share of fall FTE (mean of institutions)",
    x: {grid: true, tickFormat: "%", label: null}, y: {domain: ["2005", "2013", "2023"], axis: null}, fy: {domain: SGROUPS.map(s => s.l), label: null},
    color: {domain: ["2005", "2013", "2023"], range: ["#c3ccd5", LIGHT, BLUE], legend: true},
    marks: [Plot.barX(rows, {fy: "l", y: "f", x: "de_share_fte_mean", fill: "f", inset: 1}),
      Plot.text(rows, {fy: "l", y: "f", x: "de_share_fte_mean", text: d => pct1(d.de_share_fte_mean), dx: 4, textAnchor: "start", fontSize: 10, fill: INK})]
  });
}
```

```{ojs}

      Plot.text(rows.filter(d => d.v < 0), {fy: "l", y: "k", x: "v", text: d => s1(d.v), dx: -4, textAnchor: "end", fontSize: 10, fill: INK}),
      Plot.text(rows.filter(d => d.v >= 0), {fy: "l", y: "k", x: "v", text: d => s1(d.v), dx: 4, textAnchor: "start", fontSize: 10, fill: INK})]
```

</div>

::: {.cs-note}
Proxy: undergraduates under 18 from IPEDS fall enrollment by age (odd falls only), converted to FTE with the Digest part-time factors; the same proxy as the completion-efficiency project. Sector groups pool public master's and bachelor's colleges (regional publics) and private master's and bachelor's colleges. FY2014–24 changes use the S11 set, unweighted. No measurable spillover from state dual-enrollment growth to four-year enrollment was found. FY2024 NCES provisional.
:::
